method: Built-in image generation, AI-assisted illustrations directed by Ahimanikya
base: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 3:2 illustration for an Odia children's poetry book. Reference image is CHARACTER AND STYLE reference ONLY, change the scene and poses completely. Preserve Musha the slate-grey mouse in cream leaf-print short kurta and teal trousers, round ears and tiny black nose; Mushi the smaller warm-brown mouse in rust-red sari with cream border and gold earrings. Each mouse has exactly two forepaws/arms, two hindlegs/feet, one thin tail. Readable animal paws, no extra fingers/limbs. Warm classic Indian children's magazine ink-and-gouache cartoon, dark irregular outlines, broad flat colours and light paper grain, expressive purposeful faces, restrained shadows. No photo, 3D, human hands, words or lettering, panels or watermark. Full composition within frame.

A crow perches with a little bunch of balloons behind them. Warm busy-but-clear fair atmosphere. Musha curious, Mushi cautious, tugging his sleeve. Only these five animals; anatomically correct cat/mongoose four limbs, crow two legs two wings. Focus on mice.

An orange cat peeks sleepily from behind a low wall, making both mice look over in alarm. Playful rather than cruel. No numerals or text.

Water ripples below her. Exactly one mouse and one cobra with ONE continuous legless body and a modest hood. Musha is absent, visiting a friend. Suspenseful, child-appropriate, no contact or attack.

Bits of cloth on earth floor, no intact blanket on him, no furniture bed. Two mice only. Tender comic frustration.

Cobra ONE continuous body, no feet, two mice exactly four limbs each. No menace/contact.
